clue.text: Explore online and draw back from excess

parts.note: to surf the web is to browse it

indicators.note: read backwards: the word for draw is turned around

parts.note: a draw is a tied game, a tie

explanation.surface: Someone browsing the web pulls back from overindulgence.
explanation.walkthrough: 'draw back' reads like recoiling, but 'draw' is a tied game and 'back' tells you to read it the other way round, giving EIT.
explanation.definitionFit: A glut or overabundance of something is an excess of it.

clue.text: Greek island associated with a savoury snack

parts.note: Samos is an island in the eastern Aegean

explanation.surface: An Aegean island is known for a particular tasty nibble.
explanation.definitionFit: A samosa is a fried triangular pastry with a spiced filling, eaten as a snack.

clue.text: Horn is ordered for Leeds players

indicators.note: put into an arrangement, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A trumpet is called for by musicians in Leeds.
explanation.walkthrough: Leeds Rhinos are a rugby league club in Yorkshire, England.
explanation.definitionFit: The Leeds rugby league side is nicknamed after this animal, so its team members are this.

clue.text: Attlee gets involved with core group of voters

indicators.note: tangled up, so the letters are mixed together

explanation.surface: A former prime minister engages with his party's hardcore supporters.
explanation.walkthrough: Clement Attlee was the UK Labour prime minister after the Second World War.
explanation.definitionFit: The electorate is the body of people entitled to vote in an election.

clue.text: In Minnesota citizenship is implied

indicators.note: the letters are found within the words that follow

explanation.surface: In a US state, being a citizen is taken as understood.
explanation.definitionFit: Tacit means understood without being stated, unspoken.

clue.text: Cameron is recollected in Italian city

indicators.note: re-collected: the letters of the name are gathered up again in a new order

explanation.surface: The former prime minister is remembered in an Italian city.
explanation.walkthrough: 'recollected' looks like 'remembered' but splits as re-collected, the anagram signal.
explanation.definitionFit: Cremona is a city in Lombardy, famous for violin makers such as Stradivari.

clue.text: Noted female officer in funny cartoon

indicators.note: one part sits inside the other
odd or peculiar, so the letters come out strangely arranged

parts.note: Lt is the abbreviation for lieutenant

explanation.surface: A woman officer appears in an amusing animated film.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Noted' is the definition's joke: a female who is set to musical notes, a singer. 'funny' scrambles the film into CONTRAO, and 'in' slips the officer inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: A contralto is the lowest female singing voice, a woman singer with musical notes.

clue.text: Measure American or Australian runners

parts.note: an em is a printer's measure of width
US stands for United States, so American

explanation.surface: Measuring athletes from the US or Australia.
explanation.definitionFit: Emus are large flightless birds native to Australia that run fast.

clue.text: Single note in old, old song

indicators.note: one part goes inside the other

parts.note: O again for old
sole means one and only
mi is the third note of the sol-fa scale

explanation.surface: A lone note within an ancient melody.
explanation.definitionFit: A famous Neapolitan song of 1898, a staple for tenors.

clue.text: Testing a small saw

parts.note: a saw is a proverb or saying

explanation.surface: Trying out a little cutting tool.
explanation.walkthrough: 'saw' is not the tool but an old proverb.
explanation.definitionFit: Assaying means analysing a metal or ore to test its quality.

clue.text: Major heard where Augusta is

indicators.note: signals that a word is pronounced, giving a soundalike spelt differently

parts.note: main means chief or major, as in the main road

explanation.surface: A senior army officer listens, apparently at a famous golf course.
explanation.walkthrough: Augusta suggests the Georgia golf club, but Augusta is also the state capital of Maine.
explanation.definitionFit: Augusta is the capital of this New England state, so the state is where it lies.

clue.text: Trick panel for magicians

parts.note: a con is a swindle or trick
a jury is a panel, made up of its members

explanation.surface: A clever stunt arranged for a group of illusionists.
explanation.definitionFit: Conjurors perform sleight of hand and illusions, which is what stage magicians do.

clue.text: Leisurewear right for author's work

parts.note: shorts are casual leisure clothing
a Tory is a right-winger, a member of the UK Conservative Party

explanation.surface: Casual clothing deemed suitable for a writer at work.
explanation.definitionFit: A brief piece of prose fiction is a typical product of a writer's labour.

clue.text: A lot of birds drink, so it's said

indicators.note: the phrase tells us a word is spoken, giving one that sounds the same

parts.note: bevvy is British slang for an alcoholic drink

explanation.surface: Birds drinking, according to rumour.
explanation.walkthrough: BEVVY is informal British for a drink, especially beer.
explanation.definitionFit: A flock of birds, especially quails or larks, is called a bevy by collective noun.

clue.text: Bush supports ascendant though unintelligent player

indicators.note: in a down entry, the piece below holds up the one above it
rising, so in a down clue these letters read upwards

parts.note: if can mean though, as in pleasant if dull
dim means slow-witted
the elder is a shrub, a bush

explanation.surface: A former US president backs a rising but dim footballer.
explanation.walkthrough: 'ascendant' turns IF DIM into MIDFI; ELDER goes below it, 'supports' in a down clue.
explanation.definitionFit: A midfielder is a footballer who plays in the middle of the pitch, a team member.

clue.text: Broadly humorous Blair, afflicted with amnesia, miles away

indicators.note: troubled or disordered, so the letters are thrown out of order
gone from the word, so a letter is taken out

explanation.surface: A former prime minister, suffering memory loss, is far off.
explanation.walkthrough: 'away' removes M from AMNESIA, leaving ANESIA; 'afflicted' scrambles BLAIR with ANESIA.
explanation.definitionFit: Coarse, earthy and exuberant comedy is called Rabelaisian after the French writer Rabelais.

clue.text: Diner able to rejoin food queue

indicators.note: joined again in a new way, so the letters are reassembled

explanation.surface: A restaurant customer is fit to get back in the queue for food.
explanation.definitionFit: A breadline is a queue of poor people waiting for free food handouts.

clue.text: Girl entertaining millions with right instrument

indicators.note: hosting, so it holds another letter within

parts.note: Dulcie is a girl's name
M is the abbreviation for million

explanation.surface: A girl amusing a huge crowd with the right musical instrument.
explanation.definitionFit: A dulcimer is a stringed instrument played by striking the strings with hammers.

clue.text: Swedes, say, providing ferret with haircut

parts.note: to ferret is to root about searching
a crop is a short haircut

explanation.surface: People from Sweden supplying a pet ferret with a trim.
explanation.walkthrough: Swedes are not Swedish people here but the vegetable (rutabaga in the US).
explanation.definitionFit: A swede is an example of a vegetable grown for its edible root.

clue.text: Thatcher may be seen here presenting song by the Drifters

definitions.meaning: a thatcher is a roofer working on straw roofs, perched on top of a house
a 1962 hit by the American vocal group

explanation.surface: The former prime minister turns up singing a sixties pop hit.
explanation.walkthrough: Thatcher looks like Margaret Thatcher, but it is a craftsman who lays thatched roofs.
explanation.definitionFit: A thatcher works atop a house, and the Drifters recorded a hit by this title.

clue.text: New song about knight in realm of fantasy

indicators.note: around, so it surrounds the next piece

parts.note: an aria is a solo song in opera
N is the chess notation for knight

explanation.surface: A fresh ballad about a knight in a fairytale kingdom.
explanation.definitionFit: Narnia is the magical land in C.S. Lewis's children's books, an imaginary world.

clue.text: Tenant with a smaller amount midweek

parts.note: less means a lower quantity
the middle letters of the word week

explanation.surface: A renter paying less in the middle of the week.
explanation.definitionFit: A lessee holds a lease on property, so is a renter or occupant.

clue.text: Unable to proceed in recession, king offloaded shares

indicators.note: got rid of, so a letter is dropped
receding, going backwards, so the word is read in reverse

parts.note: stuck means unable to move on
K is the chess abbreviation for king

explanation.surface: A monarch, stalled by an economic downturn, sells off his stocks.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in recession' turns STUCK into KCUTS; 'offloaded' drops the K.
explanation.definitionFit: Cuts are portions or slices of the takings, as in everyone getting their cut.

clue.text: Fully-fledged monarch took in food for doctor

parts.note: fully grown, as a bird that has all its feathers, means adult
ER is Elizabeth Regina, the Queen
ate means consumed food

explanation.surface: A grown-up king ate a meal to treat his physician.
explanation.walkthrough: 'doctor' is the verb, to tamper with.
explanation.definitionFit: To doctor something, such as a drink, is to tamper with or contaminate it.

clue.text: Tree providing shade

definitions.meaning: a shrub or small tree with fragrant purple or white blossom

explanation.surface: A tree giving cover from the sun.
explanation.walkthrough: 'shade' looks like shelter from a tree, but it is a colour.
explanation.definitionFit: The flowering plant gives its name to a pale mauve colour.

clue.text: In Strasbourg I must accept one follower of May

indicators.note: take in, so it holds the next piece inside

parts.note: je is French for I, and Strasbourg is in France
un is French for one, continuing the French setting

explanation.surface: A French city rule: a newcomer comes after Theresa May.
explanation.definitionFit: The month of the year that comes straight after May on the calendar.

clue.text: Capricious magician dropping in to entertain court

indicators.note: to host, so one part holds the other inside it
letting fall, so these letters are removed

parts.note: Merlin is the wizard of Arthurian legend
a curia is a court, notably the papal court

explanation.surface: A fickle conjuror pops in to amuse a royal household.
explanation.walkthrough: 'dropping in' looks like visiting, but 'in' is the letters lost, leaving MERL; 'to entertain' then wraps that round the papal court's Latin name.
explanation.definitionFit: Mercurial people have rapidly changing moods, like quicksilver; that is being unpredictable.

clue.text: Brown made castles, finally, with lots of sand

parts.note: dun is a dull greyish-brown colour

indicators.note: take the closing letter of each of the two words before it

explanation.surface: Someone called Brown built sandcastles at last on a sandy beach.
explanation.definitionFit: Dunes are mounds or ridges of sand heaped by the wind, so plenty of it.

clue.text: Well-fed traveller allowed back in cafe

parts.note: a rep is a travelling sales representative
let means permitted

indicators.note: take the rear letter of the word that follows

explanation.surface: A satisfied salesman permitted to return to the cafe.
explanation.definitionFit: Replete means full up after eating, sated by a big meal.

clue.text: Conveyance with horse taken from ancient city

indicators.note: removed from, so a letter is subtracted

parts.note: Carthage was the Phoenician city in North Africa
H is slang for heroin, also called horse

explanation.surface: Transport by horse comes from a city of antiquity.
explanation.walkthrough: 'horse' is drug slang for heroin, abbreviated H.
explanation.definitionFit: Cartage is the carrying of goods by cart, a kind of transport.
